validation.emptyAutomation: Cannot save empty automation. Please add at least one trigger and one action node.
validation.noTrigger: Automation must have at least one trigger node. Please add a trigger from the node palette.
validation.noAction: Automation must have at least one action node. Please add an action from the node palette.
validation.transpileFailed: Failed to transpile flow to automation config
validation.noAutomationId: No automation ID set. Use saveAutomation() for new automations.

node.duplicateId: ID already in use — must be unique within the automation
node.unknownTriggerId: No trigger has this id: the condition never passes
node.entityIgnored: Home Assistant ignores an entity here: this type only acts on the kinds of entity it names (a door trigger, on doors)

native.thresholdRequired: Set the threshold (Home Assistant refuses this without one)
native.optionRequired: This needs a value: Home Assistant refuses it without one
native.targetRequired: Add a target (Home Assistant refuses this without one)
native.targetEmpty: No targets are selected, so this never triggers or matches
native.boundsReversed: The lower bound is above the upper one: Home Assistant refuses that

entityRequired.state: Entity is required for state triggers
entityRequired.numericState: Entity is required for numeric state triggers
entityRequired.zone: Entity is required for zone triggers

trigger.tagIdRequired: At least one tag ID is required
trigger.commandRequired: At least one sentence is required
trigger.timePatternRequired: Set hours, minutes or seconds (Home Assistant needs at least one)
trigger.entityEmpty: No entities are selected, so this never triggers
trigger.boundRequired: Set Above, Below, or both (Home Assistant needs at least one)
trigger.boundEmpty: This is empty: set a number or an entity, or clear it (Home Assistant refuses an empty value)
trigger.eventTypeEmpty: The event type is empty, so only an event with an empty name triggers this
trigger.timeEmpty: No times are set, so this never triggers
trigger.templateEmpty: The template is empty, so this never triggers
trigger.tagIdEmpty: The tag ID is empty, so only a tag with an empty ID triggers this
trigger.sourceEmpty: The source is empty, so no geolocation entity triggers this

action.serviceOrEventRequired: Either a service (e.g. light.turn_on) or an event name is required
action.serviceFormat: Service must be in domain.service format (e.g., light.turn_on)
action.fieldEmpty: A field this action needs is empty: Home Assistant saves it, but the step fails when it runs
action.oneOfEmpty: This action needs one of these filled in (or a pair of them together): Home Assistant saves it, but the step fails when it runs
action.entityUnsupported: An entity here can't do this action (it lacks a feature the action needs): Home Assistant saves it, but the step fails when it runs
action.eventEmpty: The event name is empty, so this fires an event with no name

wait.templateOrTriggerRequired: Wait node requires either a template condition or trigger. Use a Delay node for simple time-based pauses.
wait.templateEmpty: The template is empty, so this wait only ends at its timeout
wait.triggersEmpty: No triggers are set, so this wait only ends at its timeout

entityRequired.state: Entity is required for state conditions
entityRequired.numericState: Entity is required for numeric state conditions
entityRequired.zone: Entity is required for zone conditions

condition.groupConditionsRequired: At least one condition must be defined
condition.stateEmpty: The state is empty: this only matches an entity whose state is empty
condition.templateEmpty: The template is empty, so this condition is never true
condition.triggerIdEmpty: The trigger ID is empty: this only matches a trigger with an empty ID
condition.groupEmpty: This group has no conditions (and/not are then always true, or is always false)
condition.boundRequired: Set Above, Below, or both (Home Assistant needs at least one)
condition.boundEmpty: This is empty: set a number or an entity, or clear it (Home Assistant refuses an empty value)
condition.timeRequired: Set After, Before or weekdays (Home Assistant needs at least one)
condition.timeBlank: This is empty: set a value or clear it (Home Assistant refuses an empty value)
condition.weekdayEmpty: No weekdays are selected, so this condition is never true

forRefused.states: Home Assistant 2026.10 and later refuse "for" with more than one state. Clear it, or keep one state.
forRefused.attribute: Home Assistant 2026.10 and later refuse "for" with an attribute. Clear it, or clear the attribute.
forRefused.helper: Home Assistant 2026.10 and later refuse "for" with a state taken from a helper. Clear it, or type the state itself.

forRefusedLater.states: Home Assistant 2026.10 and later refuse "for" with more than one state: this stops working when Home Assistant updates. Clear it, or keep one state.
forRefusedLater.attribute: Home Assistant 2026.10 and later refuse "for" with an attribute: this stops working when Home Assistant updates. Clear it, or clear the attribute.
forRefusedLater.helper: Home Assistant 2026.10 and later refuse "for" with a state taken from a helper: this stops working when Home Assistant updates. Clear it, or type the state itself.

setVariables.atLeastOne: At least one variable must be defined
setVariables.empty: No variables are set, so this step does nothing
